title: China’s trade grip tightens in Europe as clock ticks towards October deadline

article.title: China’s trade grip tightens in Europe as clock ticks towards October deadline
article.summary: Midway through a three-month negotiating period with Beijing, new data shows the trade balances of 24 European Union member states are still moving in what Brussels considers to be the wrong direction. China extended its trade surplus over all but three EU members in July compared to a year earlier, calculations based on new Chinese customs figures showed.
